item.title: Trump-Tillis tiff deepens as president says he ‘quit,’ concedes Fed fight could doom new chair confirmation
item.summary: Kevin Warsh's Federal Reserve confirmation hearing heads to the Senate next week, but Sen. Thom Tillis, R-N.C., plans to block President Donald Trump's pick over DOJ probe.

item.title: Bahamian authorities plan to suspend search for missing American woman amid US Coast Guard criminal probe
item.summary: Lynette Hooker might never be found in the Bahamas as the country's military says it is ending the search. Her husband, Brian Hooker, plans to search on his own.

item.title: On filing deadline, GOP blasts Democrats for opposing Trump tax cuts, ‘making life more expensive’
item.summary: On Tax Day 2026, Senate GOP launches ads in seven key races targeting Democrats who voted against working families tax cuts signed by President Trump.

item.title: WATCH: Dem Senate hopeful caught plotting to silo conservative media outlets with top aide
item.summary: U.S. Senate hopeful Abdul El-Sayed said he wants to reach broader audiences, but a Hasan Piker livestream caught him asking staff to separate right-wing reporters from everyone else at a campaign event.

item.title: Kimmel, Colbert silent on Eric Swalwell scandal after platforming Democrat
item.summary: "Jimmy Kimmel Live!" and "The Late Show with Stephen Colbert" have not addressed Eric Swalwell's alleged sexual misconduct scandals on Monday or Tuesday.

item.title: Sen Kennedy warns Democrat 'loon wing' has 'fried' the party’s motherboard
item.summary: Sen. John Kennedy ripped Democratic leadership, claiming radical progressives have seized control of the party with what he calls "nauseously woke" policies.

item.title: Doctor warns wearable fitness trackers can backfire, despite Rory McIlroy's success
item.summary: Rory McIlroy tracked his heart rate during his Masters victory using a wearable device, sparking debate over whether health trackers help or harm users.

item.title: Johnson faces GOP revolt over warrantless surveillance powers ahead of key vote
item.summary: Speaker Mike Johnson faces GOP pushback on renewing FISA Section 702 warrantless surveillance powers as conservatives demand additional reform guardrails.

item.title: Missing teen found hiding in convicted sex offender's closet in Florida, sheriff says
item.summary: A convicted sex offender in Florida was arrested after a missing 17-year-old girl was found hiding in his bedroom closet in Dundee, authorities said.

item.title: Millions tap Trump tax cuts this filing season as refunds top $3,400
item.summary: Over 53 million tax filers claimed Trump's signature tax cuts this season, with the average refund climbing above $3,400, Treasury Department data shows.
